releaseNote: 更新检测新增自建清单与 Apple App Store 双源比对，自动选择较高版本并保留强制更新与分阶段发布规则；修复 2027 年除夕在月历和挂件中的显示。
releaseNoteEn: Update checks now compare the self-hosted manifest with the Apple App Store, select the newer version, preserve forced-update and phased-rollout rules, and fix Lunar New Year Eve in the 2027 calendar and widgets.
